attacker.model: claude (Kiro subagent; exact model version not exposed to the agent)

null-vs-empty.notApplicableReason: The function takes no parameter and reads no table, so no text input exists.

collation-case.notApplicableReason: No text input and no text comparison.

dates-datetime.notApplicableReason: No date input: the only date is the constant '20030701' inside the function. Its precision is attacked through the result type (A01).

numeric-rounding.notApplicableReason: No decimal or money input or result.

top-ties.notApplicableReason: Scalar function: returns one value, no rows from tables.

identity-gaps.notApplicableReason: Reads no table, no key or sequence.

cases.label: the result keeps datetime's 3-digit precision and midnight exactly (no time-zone shift, no date-only value)
cases.reasoning: T-SQL CONVERT(datetime, '20030701', 112) gives a datetime at 00:00:00.000. The conversion returns TIMESTAMP '2003-07-01 00:00:00' as timestamp(3). A timestamptz return type, a session time zone, or a date return type would change the value or its type; the result-set comparison checks the value and the column type.

objections.text: A01 sends the same complete payload as the sole hand-derived fixed case: no arguments and no tables. Both cases assert the same midnight timestamp value and type, so A01 adds no distinct attack input.
